title: One shared allow entry lets every session run the session-start installer mid-session
why: The auto-mode classifier refused a mid-session reinstall in the coordinator and runner 10 at 20:12-20:13; both kept the old copy.
source: Consultant 20:20 CST Nov 13, relaying the owner's chat 20:16 CST; triage did not see the chat. Refusal text and the classifier's reason are the consultant's read.
note: Filed 20:17 CST Nov 13. Owner ruling (a), relayed by the consultant (ruling own-reinstall-allow-a): add one autoMode.allow entry in the shared settings.json, for every repo, for exactly the session-start installer command (the curl of stable/install.sh piped to bash -s -- --cloud, and the Windows and Mac installer forms), by PR. Not a per-repo exception. settings.json autoMode.allow had no reinstall entry (consultant read). A permission-rule change: a lane builds it, test or check first where the repo tests allow lines, reviewer; a lane first checks the open allow-entry PRs for a duplicate. Needs a lane.
